declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 
BEGIN

 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null then
 show_error('0080');
 end if;

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date < trunc(v_local_date)-to_number(:global.drchg) then
 message('DRCHG parameter value is '||:global.drchg);
 show_error('8740');
 --show_error('23010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date > :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date then
 show_error('1347');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 
:ctrl_blk_1.from_day := :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date ;
END;

END;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
query_count number:=0;
assigned_count number:=0;
dup_vehicle number:=0;
ins_flg number:=0;
dup_cnt number:=0;
al_id ALERT;
al_button number;
assign_drive_id varchar2(10);
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

begin

 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
IF (:DRIVE_VEHICLES.VEHICLE_ID IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 select vehicle_type,vehicle_name,decode(decode(ltrim(rtrim(to_char(
sign(trunc(v_local_date)-nvl(trunc(fda_license_date),v_local_date+1))))),'1','Y','0','Y','N') || 
decode(ltrim(rtrim(to_char(sign(nvl(trunc(fda_license_renewal),trunc(v_local_date)+1)-trunc(v_local_date))))),'1','Y','0','Y','N'),'YY','Y','N')
 into :drive_vehicles.vehicle_type, 
 :drive_vehicles.vehicle_name, :drive_vehicles.licensed 
 from valid_vehicles 
 where vehicle_id = :drive_vehicles.vehicle_id and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and 
 nvl(decommission_date,:drives.drive_date+1) > :drives.drive_date
 and rownum=1;
 EXCEPTION when NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 show_error('13001');
 check_package_failure;
 END ;
/*Check duplicates which have not been committed */
 check_insert_rg('RG_VEHICLE0','C10C10',
 :drives.drive_id||','||:drive_vehicles.vehicle_id||',','C',dup_vehicle);

 if dup_vehicle = 1 then
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

/** check for duplicates in database **/
 select count(*) into assigned_count 
 from drive_vehicles where vehicle_id = :drive_vehicles.vehicle_id and
 drive_id = :drives.drive_id and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and 
 rownum=1;
 if (assigned_count = 1) then
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 select b.drive_id into assign_drive_id 
 from drive_vehicles a, drives b where
 a.vehicle_id = :drive_vehicles.vehicle_id and
 a.drive_id = b.drive_id and
 a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and 
 b.drive_date = :drives.drive_date and
 b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and 
 rownum=1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 if(assign_drive_id <> :drives.drive_id) then
 if(assign_drive_id is not null) then
 /* pops an alert for staff assigned to another drive */
 al_id := find_alert('WARN_ALERT');
 SET_ALERT_BUTTON_PROPERTY(al_id, ALERT_BUTTON2, LABEL, 'Yes'); 
 SET_ALERT_BUTTON_PROPERTY(al_id, ALERT_BUTTON1, LABEL, 'No'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, :drive_vehicles.vehicle_id ||' is already assigned to Drive '||assign_drive_id||'. Proceed with the assignment? ' ); 
 al_button := show_alert(al_id);
 If (al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1)then
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; 
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
/* Insert the record into Record Group */
 check_insert_rg('RG_VEHICLE0','C10C10',
 :drives.drive_id||','||:drive_vehicles.vehicle_id||',','U',ins_flg);

 if ins_flg =1 then
 message('Error while inserting into Record Group ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
END IF;
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-DELETE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare

 license_yn VARCHAR2(1);
 update_flg VARCHAR2(1);
 query_cnt number:=0;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

 cursor cur1 is select vehicle_id from drive_vehicles
 where drive_id=:drives.drive_id and 
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and 
 vehicle_id <> :drive_vehicles.vehicle_id ;

begin

 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;


 if (:drive_vehicles.licensed = 'N') then

 select count(*) into query_cnt 
 from drive_vehicles 
 where drive_id=:drives.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 if(query_cnt = 1) then
 update_flg := 'Y';
 elsif(query_cnt > 1) then
 for z1 in cur1 
 loop
 begin
 select decode(decode(ltrim(rtrim(to_char(sign(trunc(v_local_date)-
 nvl(trunc(fda_license_date),v_local_date+1))))),'1','Y','0','Y','N')||
 decode(ltrim(rtrim(to_char(sign(nvl(trunc(fda_license_renewal),
 trunc(v_local_date)+1)-trunc(v_local_date))))),'1','Y','0','Y','N'),'YY','Y','N') license 
 into license_yn 
 from valid_vehicles 
 where vehicle_id = z1.vehicle_id 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and :drives.drive_date between nvl(commission_date,to_date('01011901','MMDDYYYY')) and nvl(decommission_date,to_date('01012099','MMDDYYYY'));
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 update_flg := 'Y';
 when others then
 handle_error; 
 end;
 if license_yn = 'N' then
 update_flg := 'N' ;
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 
 end if;
 
 if(update_flg = 'Y') then
 update drives set os_ok_flag=null
 where drive_id = :drives.drive_id 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and rownum=1;
 end if;
 end if;
end ;

PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 :system.message_level := 5;
 post;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

order by a.drive_date desc
